# Redis: upgrade

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

When upgrading a Redis database, the agent must know the exact API endpoint for module upgrades. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: the exact HTTP method and path for the upgrade request. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: the exact request body schema for the upgrade payload. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: the exact authentication headers required. This compact context prevents agents from guessing upgrade procedures and breaking production databases.

Search intents:
- Redis upgrade API endpoint
- Redis module upgrade request
- Redis database upgrade procedure

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/redis-upgrade --json
